title: Advance Month Priced the Way the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement Bills
content:
**Clause.** The rent in force on the next due date is turned into the advance month the way the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement bills it:

- where the agreement's planned vacate date falls on or before the last day of its latest billed period, no further period will be billed and the advance month is zero;
- where no such vacate date is set and the agreement carries the military discount, the class's military discount is taken off that rent and the result is rounded to the cent, half up;
- otherwise the rent is used as it stands.

The planned vacate date is the one the agreement record carries while a move-out notice is in place; the latest billed period is the latest rent charge on the ledger, with its last day. The class's military discount is the rate the class sets on the class discount schedule.

## Judgement table

| Planned vacate date on or before the last day of the latest billed period | Military discount on the agreement | Advance month |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | zero |
| no such vacate date | yes | the rent less the class's military discount, rounded to the cent |
| no such vacate date | no | the rent as it stands |

## Hypothetical cases (rent in force on the next due date $165.00)

- Latest billed period 10 March to 9 April, planned vacate date 2 April: the advance month is zero.
- No vacate date, military discount carried, class discount 10%: $165.00 less 10% is $148.50.
- No vacate date, no military discount: $165.00.
